purpose: Extract reusable operating mechanisms from public business histories and apply them to DreamLedger without copying products, branding, protected expression, confidential information or identity.

mechanisms: Start from observed demand and a known sale.
Source cheaply before manufacturing heavily.
Use price as a wedge and make the complete offer obvious.
Control critical parts of the value chain when it materially improves cost, speed or reliability.
Use a low entry price to attract attention, then offer a higher-value version.
Exploit distribution partnerships and limited launches to create concentrated demand.
Move into adjacent markets when the current market saturates.
patterns.dreamledger_translation: Demand-first cell selection, low-cost tests, explicit entry offer plus higher-value path, distribution partner experiments, adjacent-cell cloning.

mechanisms: Make the difference obvious to the customer.
Use publicity and stunts when paid advertising is inefficient.
Build trust through simple, direct communication.
Challenge lazy incumbents where the customer pain is visible.
Keep the brand human and accountable.
Expand only where the existing brand/distribution advantage transfers.
patterns.dreamledger_translation: Magnetic public surface, truthful build-in-public story, trust/evidence layer, challenge weak customer experiences, clone only transferable distribution advantages.

mechanisms: Start with a known market need before attacking the largest long-term market.
Use first-principles cost decomposition.
Simplify aggressively.
Vertically integrate bottlenecks when external dependencies dominate cost or speed.
Treat the production system itself as a product.
Iterate rapidly and solve blockers at the constraint rather than adding layers.
patterns.dreamledger_translation: Known-demand wedge, cost-per-deliverable accounting, remove unnecessary architecture, own bottleneck capabilities, improve the cell factory itself, attack the current blocker.

mechanisms: Use failures as a warm distribution pool.
Launch early and treat launch as the beginning.
Contact existing networks and previous users.
Use high-frequency useful public interaction.
Clone a working distribution mechanism across multiple channels.
Turn transparent metrics and behind-the-scenes evidence into distribution.
Use unusual physical/visual publicity.
Test channels cheaply before building a permanent media operation.
Publish the real story repeatedly.
Treat marketing/distribution as a core production function.
patterns.dreamledger_translation: Warm opportunity reactivation, channel cloning, approval-ready distribution packets, truthful telemetry, Billboard as a distribution asset, rapid channel tests, public evidence narrative.

compound_patterns.name: Parasitic Overlay
compound_patterns.formula: Host Motion × Conversion Surface × Fulfillment Contract × Receipts
compound_patterns.rule: Attach to existing demand/motion instead of manufacturing traffic from zero.

compound_patterns.name: Factory-of-Cells
compound_patterns.formula: Signals → Buyers → Cells → Distribution → Payment → Fulfillment → Proof → Learning → Clone
compound_patterns.rule: The unit of scale is a verified economic mechanism, not a feature.

compound_patterns.name: Constraint Attack
compound_patterns.formula: Find the current transition blocker → remove it → remeasure
compound_patterns.rule: Do not build generalized infrastructure while a concrete economic transition is blocked.

compound_patterns.name: Story-as-Distribution
compound_patterns.formula: Real event → evidence → compelling narrative → distribution → new demand signal
compound_patterns.rule: Never fabricate traction. Make actual progress legible.

compound_patterns.name: Adjacent Expansion
compound_patterns.formula: Verified cell → identify transferable capability → test adjacent buyer/problem
